stem.text: Grain is poured into a hopper at the rate \( R(t) = 5 \sin{\left(\frac{t^{2}}{2} \right)} + 15 \) kilograms per minute, where t is measured in minutes for \( 0 \le t \le 5 \). The hopper holds 90 kilograms of grain at time \( t = 0 \). During the same time, grain drains from the bottom of the hopper at the rate \( D(t) = t + \frac{15}{2} \) kilograms per minute. Using a calculator, find the total number of kilograms that arrive during the time interval \( 0 \le t \le 4 \). Show the setup, and give the value correct to three decimal places.

worked_solution.text: The amount that arrives is the integral of the inflow rate over the interval, \( \int_{0}^{4} \left(5 \sin{\left(\frac{t^{2}}{2} \right)} + 15\right)\,dt \), and nothing is added for the starting amount or taken away.
With the calculator in radian mode, the integral is about 64.538 kilograms.

options.derivation: the amount present at the end reported, the starting amount added to the integral of the inflow
the integral evaluated with the calculator in degree mode
the rate evaluated at the endpoints and subtracted, R(b) - R(a), in place of its integral
